decisionsTitle: The page head is compact on a phone: no wordmark, a 24-pixel title, half the room above it (amending §292)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-09-29, on a screenshot of `/ro/calendar`:** «Textul ăsta de „Evenimente” e mult prea mare, pe mobil ia prea mult spațiu, la fel și la „Calendar”».

**What was there.** The listing, the calendar and the contact page open with the kit-face wordmark «BRASOV RUNNERS» (§292; `clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 2rem)`, so 20px on a phone and 32px on a desktop), then the page's H1 at the theme's 2rem (32px) at every width, then the gradient bar under it (§166's `headingRule`, 56 × 3 pixels, 8 pixels under the words), then the intro. The H1 is drawn in the display role (Roboto) on the page's own background: there is no highlight box behind it in the code, so there was none to remove. On a phone the head was the brand twice (the sticky header's lockup, then the wordmark) and a 32-pixel title in front of the first card.

**Decision.**

- *The wordmark is not drawn below `sm`.* `shared/ui/Wordmark` carries `display: { xs: "none", sm: "block" }`: the header's lockup is on the same screen and already says the club's name, one brand per screen. It is hidden by CSS, not left out on the server, because the page is one static HTML for every width served from the CDN (§549), and nothing on the server reads the viewport. From `sm` it is drawn at a flat `1rem`, half its old height.
- *The H1 is one step smaller, in the theme.* `theme.ts`'s `h1` is `1.5rem` (24px, MUI's h5 step) below `sm` and `1.75rem` (28px) from `sm`, where it was 2rem everywhere. In the theme rather than on each page, so every public H1 that takes the theme's size follows at once: the listing, the calendar, an event page, the team page, the contact page, the standing pages (`/pages/[slug]`), the FAQ, the gallery and the members' zone, and the error screens. A page that states its own size keeps it (the participant's link pages at 1.5rem, sign-in, the backoffice shell's title). The H1 stays the page's one `<h1>` and its words do not change.
- *The room is halved on a phone.* The margin above the H1 on the listing, the calendar and the contact page is a new step of the phone density scale (§380), `DENSITY.headGap`, 4 pixels where it was 8; `sm` keeps 8. The gradient bar stays at every width, since it is the title's mark of identity, and its gap under the words is 4 pixels below `sm` (was 8). MUI's `gutterBottom` is `0.35em`, so it shrinks with the title by itself (11.2 → 8.4 pixels).

**The sizes.**

| | 320 | 360 | 768 | 1280 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wordmark (was) | not drawn (20px) | not drawn (20px) | 16px (30.7px) | 16px (32px) |
| H1 (was) | 24px (32px) | 24px (32px) | 28px (32px) | 28px (32px) |
| Room above the H1 (was) | 4px (8px) | 4px (8px) | 8px | 8px |
| Bar under the words (was) | 4px (8px) | 4px (8px) | 8px | 8px |

**What was rejected.** *A shared page-head component* that every page renders: the heads are not one shape (the calendar's H1 shares a row with its «?» fold, §487, and the listing puts the last-good notice between the wordmark and the title), so one component would take props for each page's difference. The theme's variant and the density scale are already the one place. *Removing the gradient bar* to save its 7 pixels: it is what makes the title read as the page's start (§166). *Hiding the wordmark on the server by user agent*: the page is static and cached for everyone (§549). *Shrinking the H2s too*: not asked; on a phone the H1 and an H2 are now both 24px, and the bar under the H1 tells them apart.

**Tests.** Unit `tests/unit/theme/compact-page-head.test.ts` renders the wordmark and a theme H1 on the server and reads Emotion's CSS: `display:none` with `display:block` from 600px, `font-size:1rem`; the H1 an `<h1>` with its text at 1.5rem and 1.75rem from 600px; `DENSITY.headGap` on the three pages; the bar's phone gap; each page's H1 still reading its own key. `tests/unit/theme/wordmark.test.ts` pins the hide as CSS, never a client check. `tests/unit/theme/density.test.ts` has eight steps and the three new sites. E2e `tests/e2e/compact-page-head.spec.ts`: at 320 × 568 and 360 × 640, on `/ro/evenimente` the wordmark is in the HTML and hidden, the H1 is 24px, and the first card's top is at least 44 pixels above the bottom of the screen (measured on a production build with the sample data: 397.6 of 568 at 320, 374.6 of 640 at 360); on `/ro/calendar` the grid's first week row ends inside the screen (504.1 at both); on a desktop the wordmark is 16px above a 28px title on the listing, the calendar and the contact page.
changelogLine: - **A compact page head on a phone** — the «BRASOV RUNNERS» wordmark is no longer drawn below 600 pixels (the header's logo already names the club), the page title is 24 pixels on a phone and 28 from 600 pixels (was 32 everywhere), and the room above it is halved, so the first event card and the calendar's first week are on the first screen of a small phone; on a desktop the wordmark is half its old height. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the listing, the calendar or the contact page below 600 pixels, when it renders, then the kit-face wordmark is not drawn (it stays in the HTML, hidden by CSS), the page's one `<h1>` keeps its words at 24 pixels, and the room above it is 4 pixels; from 600 pixels the wordmark stands above the title at 16 pixels and the title is 28 pixels. Every public page whose H1 takes the theme's size follows the same two sizes (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the listing on a 320 × 568 or a 360 × 640 screen, when it renders with the sample data, then the first event card starts at least 44 pixels above the bottom of the first screen; and given the calendar's month grid on the same screens, then its first week row ends inside the first screen (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: a compact page head on a phone: no wordmark, a 24-pixel title
